title: Juiciopa Quchapatanpi kaq Ayllu
intro: Costa lado llaqtachapi tarikunki, chaypim olakunapa qapariyninqa qunqasqa llaqtapa susurquyninwan chaqrukun. Paykunamanmi huk kamachikuyta qoqku samanankupaq, ichaqa munapayasqankun huk castigoman aparqan, chaymantan kunankamapas ch’inlla rimanku. ¿Atiwaqchu reparayta pikunachus kasqankuta?
clues: Qocha patapin tiyarqayku, kamachiwarqankutaqmi huk p’unchay samarinaykupaq.
Chay p’unchayqa askha challwakuna hamuwaqku, ichaqa hark’awarqankun chaykunata hap’inaykupaq.
Wakinniykumantam advertirqaku mana huchallikunaykupaq, wakinñataqmi imayna kaptinpas challwanankupaq rimanakurqaku.
Ch’uya kamachikuyta p’akispaykutaqmi sinchi muchuchiyta apamurqayku.
Muchuchiyniykuqa huk t’ikrakuymi karqan, chaymi mana allin rikch’ayniyoq, p’enqaypi tarikurqayku.
Monokunamanmi tukuchiwarqaku, chaymi llapallan qipaman hamuqkunapaq señal karqa.
arabic: وَسْـَٔلْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًۭا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ ۙ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient. (7:163)
